assertions.assertion: Response explains that third-party authentication handlers need NuGet package updates for the new .NET version
assertions.rationale: It explains each third-party authentication handler is a NuGet package that must be updated to a version compatible with the new target framework (.NET 8+).

assertions.assertion: Response specifically mentions WS-Federation handler needing an update
assertions.rationale: It calls out the Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.WsFederation handler as needing to be updated to the matching .NET 8+ version.

assertions.assertion: Response mentions SAML2P handler (Sustainsys.Saml2 or equivalent) needing a compatible version for .NET 8+
assertions.rationale: It says to update Sustainsys.Saml2 to a release that explicitly supports .NET 8+/ASP.NET Core 8+.

assertions.assertion: Response recommends testing all external login flows end-to-end after migration
assertions.rationale: It insists on running each external login flow (Google, WS-Federation, SAML2P login and logout) end-to-end before considering the migration done.
